verdicts.reason: A: the 'See the Study' button sits on top of the image's bottom edge, an unwanted collision. The legal block is jammed against the end of the headline with almost no gutter. The headline and subhead are indented differently from the eyebrow, so the left edges are ragged. The subhead is much bigger than the tiny CTA, the jar shrinks to a token icon, and the logo is pushed into the bottom corner. B: the left edges line up (eyebrow, headline, subhead and CTA/jar/logo row) and the legal copy sits in its own column, but the headline butts right against the image with no gutter. The subhead is cramped under the headline, the CTA is undersized and crowded next to a tiny jar and the logo, and the legal text is barely legible, but B has fewer collisions than A.
